== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Vallenar Corporation is a massive and influential entity with a presence spanning the galaxy, including significant holdings on [[Dornoth IV]] and planetary headquarters located in the southern continent of a western hemisphere. The organization maintains its dominance through vast wealth, high-level technology, and specialized services such as the [[Sunsails|Sunsail]] line. Their operations include various subsidiaries, like Cablewright Genetics, and they possess significant influence over the galactic economy. The corporation's reach extends to media production, having funded entire movie series, and they maintain a fleet of assets ranging from courier ships to heavily armed warships and silver-and-blue battlecruisers. While they are known for their ability to procure rare goods and provide expert [[Aether Technician|Aether Technicians]] and enchanters, they are also viewed with hostility by the [[Union]], the Alliance, and the [[Free Worlds]]. Despite this widespread dislike, they remain a central power capable of negotiating with major players and offering immense resources, such as entire planets, to potential recruits. The corporation is led by a President and is associated with the Vallenar family, including figures such as [[Benri Vallenar]] and [[Varic Vallenar]].}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Vallenar Corporation is a corporate entity identifiable by its silver-and-blue uniforms and a logo featuring a stylized bird of prey formed by merging V and A characters. Specializing in the [[Sunsails|Sunsail]] line of ships and high-quality processors, the organization maintains a presence in colonies and employs highly trained, well-equipped guards. While personnel have secured sections of the [[Hive]], the company is also known for owning the proprietary [[Mirror of Silence]] spell and utilizing a magic-born clone at its headquarters. Despite the narrator blacklisting their requests due to their habit of intercepting identity inquiries, the corporation maintains good relations with the Captain and can procure rare goods in exchange for favors. The entity is associated with [[Varic Vallenar|Professor Varic Vallenar]], a former heir who wishes to be far from the company, though it remains an organization that provides assistance through a woman on the line.}}

The company is linked to the [[Mirror of Silence]] and provided the funding for the [[Starhammer]] movie series. Although the Captain is a former employee who has received multiple offers from the organization, [[Varic Vallenar]] maintains a complicated relationship with the entity and eventually abandoned it.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Headquartered on the planet Fathom, the Vallenar Corporation is a massive corporate entity led by its president, [[Benri Vallenar]]. The organization maintains assets on [[Visiria]] and utilizes a scout team alongside a heavily armed warship, though its security measures are considered inferior to those of [[Horizon]]. While [[Nila]] was once promised a position within the company and wears its uniform, the corporation has become an enemy of the crew of [[The Last Horizon]]. A Vallenar ship was recently led to the [[Dornoth system]], highlighting a power so significant that its involvement in war would devastate the galactic economy. Ultimately, [[Benri Vallenar]] possesses the [[Authority|authority]] to turn the corporation's vast resources against others.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|“Vallenar Corporation,” a woman said brightly.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c38" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|“A subsidiary of the Vallenar Corporation,” she went on<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“I don’t plan to shoot him yet,” I said. “Going to war with the Vallenar Corporation would cause even more devastation to the galactic economy than forcing an evacuation of Visiria. Which we did last week.”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c10" />}}
